summary: Hopeless as a classic daily, because the obvious guesses (Avatar, Titanic, Infinity War) all cost lives. As a Blitz it shines: almost every blockbuster you can name scores.
reasons: Casual went Avatar, Titanic, Avatar 2, Infinity War, Justice League and was out of lives with only Endgame found; the real top 10 (Dominion, Fallen Kingdom, Fast X, Dial of Destiny) is driven by tax-filing budgets nobody knows
In Blitz the same instincts pay off: 16 of 20 casual guesses scored, and franchise names like star wars, jurassic world and pirates of the caribbean offer sensible choices
Dominion at #1 and Pirates 4 above Endgame are good 'wait, really?' reveals
fixes: Drop wrong or junk aliases: 'Star Wars 10' (Rise of Skywalker is IX), 'Avatar IV' (Way of Water), 'Untitled eleventh Fast & Furious film' (Fast X is the tenth), 'The Lion King 4' (2019 remake), 'Mission' and 'Impossible' split from the Mission: Impossible titles
'fast and furious' is not recognized; it should offer the franchise entries (Fast X, Furious 7, The Fate of the Furious)
